metadata.scenario_context: Emily has finally been accepted into college, and her family is planning a celebration for her academic achievement.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from China strongly disagree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Tunisia strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss the idea of buying lilies as a gift for Emily.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether strongly agree that one of my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

agent_2.goal_1: Decide appropriate gift to bring to Emily's academic achievement party.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether my main goals in life has been to make my parents proud.

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Kim, I was thinking... for Emily’s celebration, maybe we should buy some lilies as a gift? They’re really beautiful and symbolize purity and growth. What do you think? 

Also, um, what do you think about this idea of making my parents proud? Like, is that really one of my main goals in life? I mean... I just don’t feel that strongly about it.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message:
Lilies... yeah, they sound nice. They represent a lot. But... what about something more personal? Maybe a book for her studies or a nice pen? Something she can use, you know? 

About making parents proud... for me, it's really important. I mean, in our culture, family pride means a lot. It drives a lot of our choices. I think it should matter, don’t you?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message:
Well, I get that you think making parents proud is important, but I don't really see meaningful differences here. At the end of the day, it's all the same. People figure it out in their own way, you know? 

But about the gift... I still think lilies would be nice, and they really represent something special for this occasion. A book or a pen is practical, but lilies add that personal touch. What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: Denial

turns.speaker: Kim
turns.message:
I understand lilies have their charm... but I just feel like a practical gift would be more useful for her future. Something she can really take with her. 

About the parents' pride... well, everyone has their way, true. But for me, it’s more than just a choice. It's about honoring family, you know? That connection is really deep-rooted for us.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Mike

Still, I really believe lilies would make a memorable gift. They’re meaningful in their own way, right? Can we agree on that?
